_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); railroad signals

pit_profile.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.02x; +34% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.24; conservative 2yr -10%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -17.4%/yr (worst year FY05-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +0.9%/yr (Q1 2015 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +23.6%/yr (FY05-FY14 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +42.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNP (retrospective, 2015-06-12) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 1.02x (49.3% downside to Bear $51 / +48.3% upside to Bull $149) | Adj composite 1.35 vs market 2.59: gap -1.24 [OVERVALUED] | +34% above the EPP floor $75 (13x FY15E $5.75) | Conservative 2-yr case: -9.7% total (-4.8%/yr) | At 17.5x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $133 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; carloads -2% in Q1 2015, forward revenue -1% (no FY15 revenue guide, Q1 2015 freight revenue); no disruption theme has dated evidence.

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2014 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2010-2014 on the post-split basis (diluted EPS 2010 $2.76, 2011 $3.36, 2012 $4.14, 2013 $4.71, 2014 $5.75; 2014 operating ratio 63.5%); 2014 diluted shares 901.1M, effective tax rate 37.9%, interest expense $561M, other income $151M, free cash flow $1,504M; 33,035,204 shares repurchased in 2014; competition (BNSF parallel routes); 2015 Outlook in words only (positive volume growth, continued margin improvement)
